membership: Latest run's 150 cases: question_search_10 development_cases (120) plus holdout_cases (30). These are now all development/regression comparisons. Preserve every case, split, source excerpt, cutoff and saved outcome. One original split-window label exclusion remains unscored.
question_graph: Reuse iteration 2 business_then_trade: six independent business questions in the first API call, followed by one three-class return question using those answers. No downstream statistical fitting. All arms use the same question meanings and option order. A and B express the original decimal return thresholds as equivalent percentages.

arms.raw_json: Exact earlier JSON state and questions. Reuse the 120 earlier completed two-stage judgments and request the missing 30. No retry based on prediction correctness.
arms.percent_descriptions: Keep original article passages and JSON structure. Convert decimal returns, volatilities and probabilities into explicit percentages with short descriptions, including earlier Jev answers. Relative returns are percentage-point differences; volatility is not an expected return. Monetary values, dates and counts in source text are not converted to percentages.
arms.summarized_prose: Render state as a concise natural-language string: company, source title/URL/date, deterministic source-grounded sentence summary, cutoff, all ten market observations in percentages, model reference probabilities, uncertainty and target. Summarize earlier Jev judgments in attributed sentences with percentage probabilities. This bundles state shortening, source filtering, prose formatting and simple code-computed trend descriptions; it does not isolate JSON punctuation alone. No independent generative summarizer or new facts.

source_summary: Before calls: deterministic extractive condensation, up to five whole source sentences and 200 words, prioritizing the lead, headline overlap, financial amounts, dates and concrete actions; omit obvious contact/legal boilerplate. Keep source order, selected sentence indices and all omitted numeric tokens. A long first sentence remains whole. Source summaries are labeled incomplete, not historical full text. No use of outcomes, old correctness flags or realized post-cutoff prices.
interpretation: Earlier Jev scores remain model judgments, never verified facts. Unknown never becomes unchanged or no effect. No analyst consensus, exposure, incremental financial amount, historical article version or price causation is invented. Simple sign and relative-trend descriptions are computed only from saved pre-cutoff inputs.
target: Unchanged five-session raw price return: first regular-session open after decision cutoff through fifth session close, counting entry as one; up >+1%, flat inclusive +/-1%, down <-1%. Reuse saved deterministic outcomes and evaluator without changing membership or neutral band.

response_policy.validation: Reuse strict concrete model pin, typed fields and probability-sum validator. Preserve every rejected response. Identical-request retries only, original bounded 2/5 second backoff; no retry because a forecast looks wrong.

freeze: Freeze protocol, cases, input states, source summaries, questions, outcomes and code before smoke/run. Smoke uses the first three chronological training inputs and checks transport/schema only; no outcome-driven revisions. Exactly these two new representations, no optimization loop or final-test selection.
metrics: Report full-coverage accuracy, multiclass Brier (sum of three squared errors; lower better), balanced accuracy, class confusion, response/label coverage and separate max-probability>=0.60 selective policy. Missing forecasts count wrong and incur Brier 2 for paired comparison. Report per-original-split and all150. Pair gains/losses by identical case; bootstrap by calendar month with seed2718 and 5000 draws. This is exploratory; no independent holdout claim.
intermediate_checks: Report class distributions and mean scores. Sanity screens: NASA controls should have low company relevance and unknown target revenue/cash effects; absent expectations should yield unknown surprise. Direct issuer-source relevance is a screen, not an independently adjudicated full business-accuracy label. Do not claim an overall semantic accuracy percentage.
stop: Complete three arms (one reference, two requested transformations), report all results and failures. Do not choose additional prompts or summaries after inspecting scores. Earlier experiments remain byte-unchanged.
